'''Pero''' {{Lang|zh=佩洛}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] in [[Rinascita]] and a member of the [[Troupe of Fools]]. She's almost always by [[Roccia]]'s side, the two being near inseparable, and assists her in [[Roccia/Combat|combat.]]
